# generated/ — DO NOT EDIT

Everything in this folder is **machine-written** by the tome tooling. Hand edits
here are overwritten on the next regenerate.

- `attacks.toml` — the SPELL DUEL bank. Generated from `../attacks_src.toml` by
  `tools/gen_attacks.py`. To change a duel, edit `../attacks_src.toml` (your
  reference solutions) and run, with the server up:

      python3 tools/gen_attacks.py verisearch
